choices.D: A police officer Questions 3-4 refer to the following memo. To all students, In these days, some of our school students are suffering from eye diseases. All students must wash their hands after each class. Use hot water and soap at all times. If anyone has any eye disease symptom, report it to his/her teacher. You are welcome to visit our School Health Care Center for checkup between classes. Office hours: 9 a.m. till 6 p.m. (Mon-Fri) No reservations needed. For phone counseling, call 080-114-1114.
